Needs Istio's own Bazel build of its patched Envoy; no melange path yet.
Shipped 1.0.18, the version Coolify v4.3.23 pins; 1.0.19-next and 1.0.20 are Docker Hub tags no Coolify release installs.

Beta, and it needs an Envoy 1.39 line the catalog does not have yet.
Wolfi branch snapshots, not CPython releases.
istiod already ships 1.29.8, 1.30.5 and 1.31.1. The proxy needs Istio's own Bazel-built Envoy and is not buildable here.
The step CLI bundled in the step-ca image; step-ca itself stays 0.30.2.
Wolfi git-date suffixes on the same Python releases, no new upstream version.
New 1.20 line; the recipe keeps the newest two minor lines, so 1.18 drops.
New 2026.8 line; the image ships the newest release. The arm64 build needed its FIPS crypto module compiled without Wolfi's default clang hardening flags, matching upstream.

35 still pins webauthn-lib ^4.9.1, so the 4->5 port stays, but 35 changed the code it replaces: Manager::finishAuthentication now returns AuthenticatorData and the login controller calls isUserVerified() on it. The 34-era port returns true, which would break every WebAuthn login. Needs a re-port plus the credential replay proof; 34.0.4 stays until then.
Feature releases, not LTS. The window is the LTS lines (17, 21, 25); the next LTS is 29.
13.0 is Stable but a Rolling release, not LTS; the window is the three newest LTS series.
